caption_L1: Here a is a bar diagram titled Regional unemployment rate in Italy in 2019 , by gender. There is a categorical scale from Abruzzo to Veneto on the y-axis, labeled region of Italy. Along the x-axis, Women is plotted on a linear scale from 0.00 to 0.20.
caption_L2L3: In 2019, unemployment rates in Italy for women were highest in the regions of Sicily, Campania and Calabria. The region with the lowest rate of unemployment for women was Trentino-South Tyrol with a rate of less than 0.05, the only region in Italy below this rate at that time.
